tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List all available Katzilla data agents, their categories, and tag descriptions.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Fuzzy search for specific tools/actions across all Katzilla data agents by query terms.

agent.description: Optional: Filter results to specific agent handle (comma-separated)

tools.name: get_agent_details
tools.description: Retrieve detailed tool definitions and input schemas for all actions of a specific agent.

tools.name: execute_tool
tools.description: Execute any Katzilla data agent tool/action by name with arguments.

tool_name.description: The compound tool name, formatted as 'agentHandle__actionId' (e.g., 'hazards__usgs-earthquakes')

arguments.description: The input parameters for the tool, matching its schema
